line.a_chowany.text: Let's play hide-and-seek! Bear seeks and we hide.

line.a_licze.text: I'm closing my eyes and counting to five!

line.a_raz_dwa.text: One, two, three, four, five! Coming!

line.a_nie_widac.text: I've shut my eyes, so nobody can see me!

line.a_widze.text: I can see you, Bunny! You're standing in front of the bush.

line.a_przed.text: Bunny, when you stand in front of the bush, everybody can see you. Even with your eyes shut.

line.a_za.text: To hide, you must stand behind the bush. Then the bush covers you.

line.a_rozumiem.text: I see! I'm off to find a good hiding place.

line.a_schowaj_mysz.text: Mouse wants to hide too. Drag her behind the bush.

line.a_mysz_nie.text: Bear would see her here at once. Hide Mouse behind the bush.

line.a_mysz_ok.text: I can only see her ears! Mouse is behind the bush.

line.a_szukaj.text: Help me look! See what's peeking out from behind the hiding places.

line.a_gdzie_zajac.text: Where is Bunny hiding? Point to his hiding place.

line.a_gdzie_zajac_nie.text: He's not there. Look for long ears.

line.a_mam_zajaca.text: Got you! Bunny was behind the hiding place.

line.a_gdzie_kaczka.text: And where is the duckling? Point to it.

line.a_gdzie_kaczka_nie.text: She's not there. Look for a little yellow head.

line.a_wracam.text: This time I hid properly, behind something!

line.b_zabawa.text: A new game: in front and behind!

line.b_przed.text: Put the teddy in front of the house.

line.b_przed_nie.text: In front of the house means at the front, where the door is.

line.b_przed_ok.text: The teddy is in front of the house. You can see all of him!

line.b_za.text: And now hide the teddy behind the house.

line.b_za_nie.text: Behind the house means at the back. The house should cover him.

line.b_za_ok.text: Behind the house! Only his head peeks out.

line.b_co_przed.text: What is in front of the house? Point to it.

line.b_co_przed_nie.text: She's behind the house, hidden. What stands at the front?

line.b_co_za.text: And who is hiding behind the house? Point to them.

line.b_co_za_nie.text: The ball lies at the front. Who's peeking out from behind the house?

line.b_koniec.text: The ball in front of the house, the hen behind it!

line.p_start.text: Let's play in front and behind! I have five games.

line.p_mysz_nie.text: Mouse must be hidden, behind the box.

line.p_kaczka.text: Put the duckling in front of the basket.

line.p_kaczka_nie.text: In front of the basket, so she can be seen.

line.p_kto.text: Who is hiding behind the bush? Look at what's peeking out and point.

line.p_kto_nie.text: Look again at what is peeking out from behind the bush.

line.p_fotel.text: What is in front of the armchair? Point to it.

line.p_fotel_nie.text: The teddy is hiding behind the armchair. What is at the front?

line.p_glaz.text: Hide the bunny behind the big stone.

line.p_glaz_nie.text: The bunny must be hidden, behind the stone.

line.h_dom.text: We play hide-and-seek at home too! The teddy is hiding.

line.h_gdzie.text: What is the teddy hiding behind? Point to it.

line.h_gdzie_nie.text: He's not there. Look for little paws peeking out.

line.h_za_zaslona.text: Behind the curtain! His paws were peeking out.

line.h_pilka.text: Put the ball in front of the armchair, so it can be seen.

line.h_dobrze.text: The ball is in front of the armchair. You can see it!

line.h_rodzice.text: Play hide-and-seek with your parents: behind the door, behind the armchair, behind the curtain. And remember: in front, everybody can see you!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for playing hide-and-seek! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the bush Mouse hid behind. We got it when we learnt what is in front and what is behind.
